newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil may dollarize 16 bln-real Itaipu debt-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil may dollarize 16 bln-real Itaipu debt-paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government is studying a plan to convert to dollars the bi-national Itaipu hydroelectric dam's 16 billion-real debt to state power firm Eletrobras, a local newspaper said.

Gazeta Mercantil quoted company president Jose Firmino as saying the move may be the only way to make the debt, which is inflation-adjusted over a 10-percent annual interest rate, compatible with income, which is already in dollars.
The Itaipu dam is half-owned by Paraguay.
The debt dollarization proposal comes from the giant hydropower project's Paraguayan partners, who are worried that the debt may rise much faster than income, the paper said.
"We cannot let that happen to Itaipu," Eletrobras' Firmino said, according to the paper.
Gazeta also quoted Itaipu Binacional's managing director, Euclides Scalco, as saying dollarization talks are preliminary and the board of directors has not made a decision yet.
